description: Create a Markdown Spreadsheet. At most 50 columns, 1,000 data rows, and 1,000 characters per cell. The sheet markdown must be 24,000 bytes or smaller. columns is the header row. rows are data cells. Formulas start with =. Sign payload {title, content:{kind:"markdown", markdown}} where markdown is sheetMarkdown({name, columns, rows}) from /agent-client.mjs. Default sheet name is Sheet1.
name: create_spreadsheet
title: Create a Markdown Spreadsheet
